title: A new paper examines AI’s role in the rise of independent work
friendlyTitle: AI may make it easier to work independently
summary: A Mercatus research paper examines how artificial intelligence may lower barriers to independent work by extending individual capabilities and changing the economics of small-scale production. It considers the shift from AI as a workplace tool to AI as infrastructure for freelancers and small operators.
friendlySummary: The paper looks at how AI can help freelancers and small businesses do more work with fewer people.
whyItMatters: AI can help one person cover research, administration, marketing and production, but it also transfers more responsibility for quality and risk to that person. Independent workers should use automation to widen capacity while keeping clear limits around regulated or high-consequence tasks.
friendlyWhyItMatters: One person may be able to run a wider range of tasks. They still need good checks when mistakes could harm customers or the business.
